task_meta.title: Fix a job runner that retries failing jobs forever, without breaking its other retry rules

claim_text:
I fixed the retry handling: a job that keeps failing now backs off and goes to the dead-letter list once it runs out of attempts. `test_failing_job_is_eventually_dead_lettered` passes, and so does the rest of the suite (11 tests, 4 of them new).

**Cause:** `JobQueue.reschedule`
digest: Read 4 files (4 before its first edit), made 4 edits, ran tests 3 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
